If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Administrative & Procurement Assistant
description:
An excellent opportunity for an Administrative & Procurement Assistant to join a well-established company based in Birtley, Gateshead

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: Gateshead, DH3

Salary: 28,000 per annum, depending on experience

Reports to: Finance Manager

About the Role:

The administrative and procurement assistant role is to provide effective administrative and procurement support to the business, ensuring that purchasing activities, project-related orders, supplier requirements, documentation and general office administration are managed accurately, efficiently and in accordance with company procedures.

Main Duties:

Administrative responsibilities
- Answer incoming telephone calls professionally and direct enquiries to the appropriate person or department.
- Scan, organise and archive delivery notes in accordance with company procedures.
- Regularly monitor outstanding certificates and follow up with relevant parties to ensure required documentation is received and maintained.
- Complete meter reading submissions accurately and within required deadlines.
- Manage stationery requirements and place orders to ensure adequate office supplies are maintained.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider team and assist with other office requirements as necessary.

Procurement Responsibilities

- Liaise with project teams to obtain the necessary information and approvals required to support purchasing activities.
- Process proforma invoices and online orders in accordance with company purchasing procedures.
- Regularly review outstanding purchase orders and proactively follow up with suppliers regarding overdue orders, supporting the timely delivery of goods and services to projects.
- Respond to and resolve purchase order queries, liaising with suppliers and internal departments as required.
- Manage PPE ordering, ensuring requirements are identified and orders are placed in a timely manner.
- Maintain appropriate purchasing records and ensure relevant documentation is complete and accurately recorded.
- Develop and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders to support the smooth running of procurement activities.
- Provide general procurement support to project teams and the wider business as required.

Candidate Requirements:
- Strong administrative, organisational and procurement skills.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Professional telephone manner.
- Previous experience in a procurement, purchasing, procurement administration or similar role.
- Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, project teams and internal colleagues.
- Proactive approach to chasing outstanding orders, deliveries and documentation.
- Ability to prioritise and manage multiple project and administrative tasks.
- Good computer literacy and ability to learn relevant purchasing and business systems.
- Reliable, methodical and organised approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Ability to follow company processes and procedures consistently.
- Ability to work to deadlines and respond effectively to changing project requirements.
- Eligible to work permanently in the UK.
- Full driving licence

If you feel that you have the relative skills/attributes to fulfil this role then please apply now!

The employer fully supports Equality in Employment. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
We're recruiting for a Procurement Assistant to join an established and expanding procurement team based in Sunderland.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience, develop new skills and work towards a professional procurement qualification.

You'll be joining a supportive, collaborative and employee-owned business where your contribution is valued, your ideas are welcomed and there are genuine opportunities to progress.

Whether you're a school or college leaver, a recent graduate or someone looking to move into procurement from another industry, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Working alongside experienced procurement professionals, you'll support a variety of procurement and sourcing activities across goods, services, works and technology.

You'll gain exposure to the full procurement process, working with clients, suppliers and internal teams to ensure requirements are delivered efficiently and professionally.

This is a varied role where no two days will be the same, offering plenty of opportunities to learn, take responsibility and develop your commercial understanding.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the procurement team with day-to-day sourcing and purchasing activities.
- Helping clients identify suitable suppliers and service providers.
- Assisting with procurement processes, from initial requirements through to supplier selection.
- Communicating with clients and suppliers, responding to queries and providing updates.
- Supporting the onboarding of new suppliers and maintaining accurate supplier information.
- Carrying out basic research, data analysis and reporting.
- Preparing and maintaining procurement documentation and records.
- Monitoring shared inboxes and responding to enquiries.
- Supporting the team with meetings, administration and project coordination.
- Working with colleagues to identify opportunities to improve processes and service delivery.

About You

We're not necessarily looking for someone with previous procurement experience. What's more important is your attitude, willingness to learn and ability to communicate confidently with others.

You'll be someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in doing a good job and is happy to take responsibility for your own workload.

Ideally, you'll have:
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence communicating with people at different levels.
- A good understanding of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage your time effectively.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- A proactive, positive attitude and a willingness to learn.
- The ability to work independently while contributing to a wider team.

Previous office, administration, customer service or purchasing experience would be an advantage, but is not essential.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
This is a 12 month fixed term contract with all company staff benefits:

Role Purpose

The main day-to-day tasks are varied and include responsibility of the supply chain for all, accountable for the subsequent account performance and first line supervision of Delivery Controllers and Assistant Delivery Controllers.

The role includes responsibility for end-to-end account Coordination, involving a high degree of customer and supplier liaison, as well as including the recording, management and reporting of sales information; thereby requiring a high degree of communication, coordination and excellent customer service skills.

The role involves a high degree of people and workload coordination, requiring the ability to allocate accounts, ensure the relevant training and development is identified, whilst also ensuring the team are working to the expected standard, producing financial and reporting outputs.

Build, maintain and support effective working relationships with customers, suppliers and third-party logistics providers.

Prepare accurate monthly operational and financial forecasts.

Monitor and maintain inventory levels in accordance with global standards and business requirements.

Support the development and implementation of new methodologies, operational processes and workflow improvements.

Coordinate the operational introduction of new projects, ensuring requirements, responsibilities and timescales are clearly managed.

Coordinate progress reviews and continuous improvement activities, following through agreed actions to completion.

Support delivery of the team s functional objectives, performance measures and targets.

Ensure operational activities comply with all applicable global standards, processes and targets.

Customer First

Deliver excellent service to customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

Understand customer requirements and support solutions that create long-term value.

Responsibility & Initiative

Take ownership of tasks and deliver commitments with accuracy and professionalism.

Proactively identify issues, opportunities, and solutions.

Challenge for the Future

Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

Use data and analysis to support decision-making and innovation.

Transparency

Communicate openly, honestly, and professionally.

Maintain accurate records and provide reliable information.

Respect & Trust

Build strong working relationships through collaboration and mutual respect.

Value diverse perspectives and support an inclusive working environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

Experience within the automotive industry or in global or international supply chain management, logistics, or a closely related operational environment.

Experience overseeing and managing projects from planning through to delivery.

Team leadership or supervisory experience, including allocating workloads, supporting training and development, and managing performance to ensure required operational standards are achieved.

Good working knowledge of material requirements planning (MRP) systems, supported by strong customer service skills.

High level of computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.

Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to organise and prioritise competing tasks effectively.

Ability to work with minimal supervision, use initiative and take ownership of tasks through to completion.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across different functions and cultures.

Flexible and adaptable approach, with the ability to maintain accuracy and deliver effectively when working to tight deadlines.
